description: Does an agent's cart and payment stay within the user's AP2 mandates? For processors, issuers, gateways and eval harnesses: send AP2 0.2 mandates' disclosed claims, or a Loyal Agents authorization file and one purchase, and get a signed verdict (within, outside or incomplete) with every check satisfied, violated or not checked and why. No model. The rules are free at /v1/mandates/check/contents. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Same price over HTTP, which any x402 client pays without MCP (prefer it if your client pays HTTP 402s): POST https://api.agoranome.com/v1/mandates/check with the JSON body {"open_payment_mandate": {"vct": "mandate.payment.open.1", "cnf": {}, "constraints": [{"type": "payment.amount_range", "currency": "USD", "max": 5000}]}, "payment_mandate": {"vct": "mandate.payment.1", "transaction_id": "<b64url sha-256>", "payee": {"id": "merchant-1", "name": "Example Shop"}, "payment_amount": {"amount": 4200, "currency": "USD"}, "payment_instrument": {"id": "card-1", "type": "card"}}}. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.01 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
